hints.title: Lexicographical Neighbor Property
hints.text: If any string in a collection is a prefix of another, they will appear adjacent to each other when the collection is sorted in alphabetical order.

hints.title: Sort the Array
hints.text: Sort the given array of strings lexicographically so that any potential prefix candidate immediately precedes the longer string.

hints.title: Adjacent Prefix Check
hints.text: Iterate from index 1 to n - 1 and verify whether the current string starts with the preceding string. If so, return false.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of phone number strings
L: maximum length of a string
complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(N * L * log N) and linear pass takes O(N * L).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs takes O(N^2 * L), which is slow when N is large.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting in-place uses constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that sorting brings prefix pairs adjacent to each other.
